rule: VERBATIM. These are other people's words about Rheana. Nothing in `text` may be edited, corrected, shortened, reordered or tidied - not spelling, not grammar, not pronouns. items.name: Michael Jay Makiling
items.title: Project Manager & Software Developer
items.text:
Working with Rheana as her Project Manager was honestly a great experience.

She's extremely proactive and doesn't wait to be told what to do. If something felt off or could turn into a problem later on, Rheana would call it out early and already have a few possible solutions in mind. That mindset saved the team a lot of time and back-and-forth.

She's also very easy to work with because of how clear and direct her communication is. Rheana can lead meetings confidently, keep discussions focused, and coordinate with the right people without things getting messy. Even when dealing with complex or unclear requirements, she knew how to ask the right questions and move things forward.

On top of that, she's detail-oriented, goal-driven, and takes real ownership of her work. From a PM's point of view, she's someone you can rely on. You don't have to chase updates or worry about follow-through.

I'd gladly work with Rheana again and would recommend her to any team looking for an AI Developer who's not just technically strong, but also great at collaboration and leadership.

items.text:
I had the pleasure of working closely with Rheana in two different capacities, and both experiences left me consistently impressed by her leadership and reliability.

As Education Committee Head of the UPLB Computer Science Society during my term as President, Rheana was someone I could always count on. She managed a demanding set of responsibilities without ever letting anything slip. Her events and plans were always well thought out and consistently delivered on time. What stood out most was how she prepared her successor. She made it a point to pass on everything she knew to the next person in line, making sure the committee's work would continue smoothly even after her term ended. That in itself speaks a lot about her character as a leader.

I also had the opportunity to work with her on a university project, where she served as Project Manager while I led the Backend team. She kept the team on track and organized, making sure our sprint goals were met and that the app was completed on schedule. Her ability to coordinate a team, manage timelines, and keep everyone aligned toward the same goal was key to the project's success.

Beyond her skills, Rheana is simply a joy to work with. She's dependable, hardworking, and brings genuine care to every person and project she touches. Any team would be lucky to have her, and I'm just as grateful to call her a friend as I am a former teammate.
